text: Analyse how the extract from Stranger Things constructs meaning, including the specific
representations of individuals/groups/events/places, through the following technical elements:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• sound
• mise-en-scène
• editing.
Extract: Stranger Things (season 1, episode 1, ‘The Vanishing of Will Byers’, 2016 dir. The Duffer
Brothers) [25]
Section B: Media contexts
Answer one question from Section B.
You should make references to at least one case study in your answer.
EITHER
To what extent are your own media consumption practices typical of wider trends? [25]
OR
Analyse the importance of particular production technologies in the media area you have studied.
